<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak at m/z 127.0997 likely corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]+. Subtracting the proton mass (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈126.0924 Da. By solving for a formula containing C, H, O, and one other element (N) that matches this exact mass, the best fit is C₇H₁₂NO (exact mass 126.0919 Da, within 0.001 Da of the observed value). No halogen pattern is present, supporting this assignment.</thought>
<final_answer>C7H12NO</final_answer>
